こんにちは！あなたの作品が大好きで、私のキャラクターのイラストをまたお願いできれば光栄です。

彼女は、食虫植物のような擬態能力を持つアンドロイドです。人間の感情を持たず、理解することもできないため、その行動は予測不能で、読みづらいと感じられることがあります。彼女の存在には静かな距離感があり、まるで人間の論理とは異なる何らかの論理に従って行動しているかのようです。たとえ彼女が落ち着いて見えても、周囲の空気にはどこか微妙に不気味な雰囲気が漂っています。

描く際はご自由に、デザインを簡略化したり調整したりしても全く構いません。
ご検討いただき、本当にありがとうございます >< ♥！

https://ibb.co/album/GnRqLh

I would like to request art of my character, "The Conductor System". They are an artificial intelligence"RPG Status Window" in a Hunter/Rift/Dungeon manga setting that is themed around the world of music and sound. They are impassive and without emotions; very robot-like, as a computer should be.

(They wish to someday sing their own song instead of conducting ones that were written for them.)

motifs:
- orchestral conductor: the being who leads the written symphonia
- the faulty divine machine: a disposable mechanism created by god.
- artificial sentience and the birth of autonomy— a glitch that births an unknown path.
- rubber ducks:  this is referencing "rubber duck debug" in computer programming.

appearance:
- please remember the two beauty marks underneath the left eye!

I would like to request alternate versions both with the mosaic as well as their naked face.
If you choose to draw the visor, please also include a version that shows their face.

thank you very much! (o^ ^o)♡
